DATA_EXPORTS.TITLE: Data exports
DATA_EXPORTS.DESCRIPTION: Get a ZIP with spreadsheets you can open in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers, readable conversation transcripts and original files. Downloads are available for 7 days.
DATA_EXPORTS.EXCLUSIONS: Shopify product catalog, credentials, assistant instructions and internal strategy are excluded.
DATA_EXPORTS.PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Download a copy of your contacts, conversations and knowledge. Choose what to include, track preparation and download it when it’s ready.
DATA_EXPORTS.DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Choose what to include. We’ll prepare your ZIP in the background; you can continue working while it’s being created.
DATA_EXPORTS.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create an export to keep a copy of your contacts, conversations or knowledge library.
DATA_EXPORTS.ACTIVE: An export is already being prepared. You can create another when it finishes.
DATA_EXPORTS.DOWNLOAD_ERROR: We could not download this export. Refresh the list and try again.

CONTENTS.all: Contacts, conversations with private notes and attachments, and your knowledge library.
CONTENTS.contacts: A contact spreadsheet with names, email addresses, phone numbers and custom fields.
CONTENTS.conversations: Conversation and message spreadsheets, readable transcripts, private notes and original attachments.
CONTENTS.knowledge: Articles, documents and FAQs as spreadsheets, plus original documents and native knowledge archives.
